maya_r: Heads up — nightly marathon-100k flagged an increase in dropped instruction tails for quantized candidate rwd-1.2q on legal-marathon-v3. Example below.

samir_k: Quick paste of a minimal prompt + failing snippet?

maya_r: PROMPT:
```
Extract the mandatory compliance steps and enumerate them. Context: <very long contract text elided here for thread>
```

MODEL OUTPUT (rwd-1.2q):
```
1) Retention requirements for user data.
2) Access control responsibilities.
3) Audit logging procedures.

[...lots of contract content omitted...]

8) Termination clauses.
9) Liability provisions.

The model then repeats a previous clause and omits the expected continuation (steps 10-13) that contain critical multi-paragraph instructions.
```

lucy_w: I ran a bisect across our nightly artifacts — regression introduced between build tag 2026-03-04_r1 and 2026-03-05_r2. The main change was the "kv-slot-prune" buffer reclaim refactor plus a small reorder in quantized load path. @cheng FYI.

cheng: If fp16 variants are OK that strongly points to a quantized-path timing window. Could be a read-after-free style interaction when reclaim runs while tail reads are in-flight.

samir_k: Can we confirm whether this reproduces on both A10 and H100? Also whether it appears only at extreme context sizes.

maya_r: Reprobed: fails consistently on rwd-1.2q on both A10 and H100, with max-context >= 100k. rwd-1.2-fp16 passes same samples. Reproduced across seeds 7, 42, 99.

lucy_w: Local repro command (internal eval harness):
```
# repro (internal)
python tools/eval_repro.py \
  --model rwd-1.2q \
  --promptset legal-marathon-v3 \
  --seed 42 \
  --max-context 110000 \
  --trace kv,mem,io \
  --out repro/1708009999
```
Traces (attached to RWD-ENG-4528) show tail read spans truncated immediately after a slot-prune event.

ci-bot: ci: nightly-eval alert for rwd-1.2q: instruction-continuity metric exceeded threshold (+11% failures vs baseline).

maya_r: Created ticket RWD-ENG-4528 and linked traces + minimal repro. Assigned eng-runtime. Also flagged ops for potential rollback window.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Noticing increased regressions in hosted traffic for rwd-1.2q. No auto-rollback triggered; opening notification to oncall.

cheng: Plan: revert aggressive kv-slot-prune reorder and add a guard to defer prune until active-reader counters are zero. Will run a canary and re-run marathon set. ETA ~3-5h.

samir_k: Please add a focused unit test that simulates concurrent tail-read + slot-prune on quantized cache (interleave sleeps/timers). Also add coverage for different batch interleavings.

lucy_w: Quick experiment: inserting a 40ms backoff between consecutive tail reads makes the failure disappear on my repro machine — consistent with a race.

maya_r: For immediate mitigation, can we add a conservative config override for Dedicated/Hosted clusters to delay aggressive prune on rwd-1.2q until fixed? That would reduce customer impact while we validate.

cheng: Good call. I'll prepare a canary revert and a config knob to tune prune aggressiveness. Will post build ID here when ready.

maya_r: Adding note: let's also throw the failing prompts into the longctx regression dashboard and create an "instruction-continuity" alert (trigger when generation cuts >8 tokens earlier than baseline).

samir_k: Thanks — marking follow-ups in the ticket: unit test, revert PR, canary runs, dashboard alert.

maya_r: Keeping thread for updates. Drop any trace or log attachments into RWD-ENG-4528.
